# f5xc_dc_cluster_group (Data Source)

A DC Cluster Group represents a collection of sites that<br>can directly communicate with each other using the underlay network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Dc Cluster Group - Full

data "f5xc_dc_cluster_group" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_dc_cluster_group.example.name
  namespace = f5xc_dc_cluster_group.example.namespace
}
```
